ownmods.toolswap.title: Tool swap
ownmods.toolswap.description: Replaces broken tools and can auto-select the recommended mining tool.
ownmods.toolswap.enabled.tip: When a mining tool breaks while breaking a block, insert an eligible replacement from inventory.
ownmods.toolswap.auto.tip: Automatically select pickaxe, axe, shovel or hoe according to vanilla mining tags.
ownmods.toolswap.enchanted.tip: When disabled, enchanted tools are never selected automatically from inventory.
ownmods.toolswap.policy.tip: Controls quality tiers eligible for replacement and auto selection.
ownmods.toolswap.policy.same.tip: Iron only replaces iron, diamond only diamond, etc. If the held item has no known tier, the best matching tool is used.
ownmods.toolswap.policy.worse.tip: Prefer the same tier, otherwise the highest lower tier. Wood < Gold < Stone < Copper < Iron < Diamond < Netherite.
ownmods.toolswap.policy.best.tip: Use the highest matching tier, then the tool with the most durability.
